content: 1. Ensure that the search information box is present on every page. 2. The search information box template must be positioned at the top of each page. 3. You can add this template to a page by typing it in the appropriate location. 4. Place the search information box below any other navigational boxes that are already present on the page. 5. Correct all hyperlinks on the page to ensure there are no broken or red links remaining. 6. To fix broken links, you can either add the missing page, remove the hyperlink, or create a redirect to an existing page. 7. Addressing broken links includes fixing those within the information boxes and navigational boxes located at the top of the page.
